items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: So I get the call from Count Basie... we want you to join the band... Two months after I joined the band we were sitting on the same stage... I actually had Sammy Davis come up and say, 'great job.' I remember Basie just looking up and smiling at me

ctx.x: Did he call himself Count? Do you recall?
I think he called himself Bill.
